description: Admin pages + Dashboard + Developer dashboard cyberpunk redesign. Covers: /servers/[guildId]/dashboard, all /servers/[guildId]/admin/* pages (tournaments list, new tournament wizard, tournament detail, participants, matches, finalize, results, analytics, settings, payment), and /servers/[guildId]/developer. All Prisma queries, API calls, auth guards, role checks, and client-side fetch logic are preserved exactly. Only JSX, CSS, and animation are modified. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: 1. Upgrade apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/dashboard/page.tsx. Keep all 8 parallel Prisma queries and KPI computation. Visual upgrades: each GlassCard KPI card gets neonColor based on value type (red for disputes/pending, green for completion, cyan for fill rate, default violet for others); add motion.div staggerChildren wrapper around the KPI grid so cards animate in on load using counterPop variant; KPI icon colours map to their neon accent; 'OVERVIEW' heading in NeonText glitch; add a CyberBreadcrumb; currently-live KPIs get a StatusPulse 'live' dot next to the label. File: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/dashboard/page.tsx

2. Upgrade apps/web/src/components/admin/TournamentAdminTable.tsx (read it first). Keep all TanStack Table logic, sorting, pagination, status update API calls. Visual upgrades: table container is a GlassCard hud; header row gets neon cyan bottom border; active sort column header shows neon violet caret; status cell uses upgraded Badge component; row hover gets bg-[rgba(124,58,237,0.06)]; action buttons (publish/cancel/edit) use GlowButton sm variants (primary/ghost/destructive); add a 'NEW TOURNAMENT' GlowButton cyber at the top right linking to new tournament page; tournament count in NeonText. File: apps/web/src/components/admin/TournamentAdminTable.tsx

3. Read and upgrade apps/web/src/components/admin/TournamentDetailPanel.tsx. Keep all API mutation calls. Visual upgrades: tabs (Details/Registrations/Stages/Matches) use Radix Tabs with neon active indicator (border-b-2 border-[#7c3aed] text-white on active, text-white/50 on inactive); registration rows get status Badge upgrades; match rows in stage sections get live-indicator for LIVE status; GlassCard hud for each panel section; NeonText section headers. File: apps/web/src/components/admin/TournamentDetailPanel.tsx

4. Upgrade the TournamentWizard and all 6 Step components (apps/web/src/components/admin/tournament-wizard/). Read TournamentWizard.tsx and WizardStepIndicator.tsx first. Visual upgrades: WizardStepIndicator — completed steps get a neon green checkmark, active step gets neon violet ring + pulse glow, future steps are dim; each step card is a GlassCard neonColor='violet'; form inputs get neon focus rings (see FEAT-003 step 6 pattern); step navigation buttons use GlowButton primary/ghost; wizard container has .hud-grid-bg background; NeonText 'CREATE TOURNAMENT' header. Files: apps/web/src/components/admin/tournament-wizard/TournamentWizard.tsx, WizardStepIndicator.tsx, Step1General.tsx, Step2Registration.tsx, Step3Schedule.tsx, Step4Scoring.tsx, Step5Awards.tsx, Step6Discord.tsx

5. Read and upgrade apps/web/src/components/admin/ParticipantsTable.tsx (check existence via file search if needed). Keep all logic. Visual upgrades: same table pattern as TournamentAdminTable — GlassCard hud container, neon header border, status Badge, row hover; approve/reject buttons use GlowButton primary/destructive sm. File: apps/web/src/components/admin/ParticipantsTable.tsx (create stub if missing — check first)

6. Read and upgrade apps/web/src/components/admin/MatchSchedulerPanel.tsx. Keep all match update API calls and accordion logic. Visual upgrades: tournament accordion triggers use GlowButton ghost with a neon arrow chevron; match rows get a colour-coded left border by status (live=red, completed=green, scheduled=cyan, default=violet); scheduled datetime inputs get neon focus rings; 'MATCH SCHEDULER' in NeonText. File: apps/web/src/components/admin/MatchSchedulerPanel.tsx

7. Read and upgrade apps/web/src/components/admin/ResultsQueue.tsx and ResultReviewCard.tsx. Keep all PATCH API calls and dispute handling. Visual upgrades: ResultReviewCard becomes a GlassCard neonColor='red' for disputed items, neonColor='cyan' for under-review; approve button GlowButton primary, reject GlowButton destructive; scorecard JSON display in a monospace pre block with neon-border-cyan; 'RESULTS QUEUE' in NeonText. Files: apps/web/src/components/admin/ResultsQueue.tsx, apps/web/src/components/admin/ResultReviewCard.tsx

8. Read and upgrade apps/web/src/components/analytics/AnalyticsDashboard.tsx. Keep all Recharts charts and API fetch logic. Visual upgrades: Recharts chart colours changed to neon palette (violet #7c3aed, cyan #06b6d4, green #22c55e, red #ef4444); chart containers become GlassCard hud; chart tooltips get dark bg matching --color-bg-card; export button uses GlowButton ghost; filter controls (date range, game select) get neon focus rings; KPI summary cards at top use GlassCard neonColor mapping; 'ANALYTICS' heading in NeonText. File: apps/web/src/components/analytics/AnalyticsDashboard.tsx

9. Read and upgrade apps/web/src/components/admin/ServerSettingsPanel.tsx. Keep all PATCH/POST API calls for settings, overlay token generation, logo upload. Visual upgrades: settings sections become GlassCard hud containers with NeonText section headers; colour picker for accentColor gets a live neon preview swatch; channel selects get neon focus rings; 'Generate Overlay Token' button GlowButton cyber; save button GlowButton primary; dangerous actions (reset) GlowButton destructive. File: apps/web/src/components/admin/ServerSettingsPanel.tsx

10. Read apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/payment/page.tsx and apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/payments/PaymentsTabs.tsx and apps/web/src/components/admin/PaymentConfigPanel.tsx. Keep all Razorpay/payment API calls. Visual upgrades: PaymentConfigPanel — GlassCard hud for config form, neon focus rings, GlowButton primary save; PaymentsTabs — Radix Tabs with neon active indicator same as TournamentDetailPanel; order rows in table get neon status badges (paid=green, pending=amber, failed=red). Files: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/payment/page.tsx, PaymentsTabs.tsx, PaymentConfigPanel.tsx

11. Read and upgrade apps/web/src/components/admin/FinalizeButton.tsx. Keep all finalize API calls and confirmation logic. Visual upgrades: button becomes GlowButton destructive with a confirmation modal (use a simple state-controlled div overlay with GlassCard neonColor='red') instead of window.confirm if currently using it; modal has NeonText 'CONFIRM FINALIZE' heading. File: apps/web/src/components/admin/FinalizeButton.tsx

12. Read and upgrade apps/web/src/components/developer/DeveloperDashboard.tsx and all 4 tab components (BridgeHealthTab.tsx, BotAnalyticsTab.tsx, BotErrorsTab.tsx, WebsiteErrorsTab.tsx). Keep all data props and API fetch logic. Visual upgrades: DeveloperDashboard — NeonText 'DEVELOPER DASHBOARD' with glitch, StatusBar at top; Radix Tabs get neon active indicators per tab colour (bridge=cyan, bot-analytics=violet, bot-errors=amber, website-errors=red); BridgeHealthTab — each health check becomes a GlassCard with StatusPulse (synced/offline/critical based on status field), latency shown in mono; BotAnalyticsTab — top commands list gets a horizontal bar chart using divs with neon gradient fills proportional to count; BotErrorsTab/WebsiteErrorsTab — error rows get GlassCard neonColor='red', stack traces in mono pre blocks with neon-border-cyan. Files: apps/web/src/components/developer/DeveloperDashboard.tsx, BridgeHealthTab.tsx, BotAnalyticsTab.tsx, BotErrorsTab.tsx, WebsiteErrorsTab.tsx
acceptance_criteria: All admin component files compile without TypeScript errors
No Prisma queries, auth guards, role checks, or API fetch calls were modified
TournamentAdminTable preserves TanStack Table sorting and pagination
AnalyticsDashboard Recharts charts use neon colour palette
DeveloperDashboard renders with NeonText header and neon tab indicators
